utilization_conditions.summary: 默认官方 Presto coordinator 无认证暴露 /v1/statement 时，匿名 HTTP 客户端带 X-Presto-User 连续提交大量约 700KiB SQL 且不轮询 nextUri，可线性保留 Query/session 对象并触发默认 1GiB heap OOM。
limits_or_mitigations: Default query.max-length is 1,000,000 characters, but the observed abandoned-initial-POST path retains the statement before dispatch-time maxQueryLength enforcement.
The probe did not observe a pre-dispatch request-body cap below 700000 bytes.
Enabling HTTP authentication or putting /v1/statement behind trusted network access changes attacker reachability.
Reverse-proxy body-size, rate, or per-client request quotas can raise or remove exploitability.
A server-side TTL/quota for unpolled queued statements would mitigate this retention path.
not_affected_when: /v1/statement is not reachable by anonymous or low-trust clients.
HTTP authentication is enabled and only trusted users can submit statements.
A proxy or gateway rejects large or high-rate statement submissions before Presto allocates Query state.
The implementation removes or bounds unpolled queued statements independently of query dispatch completion.

trigger.request_shape: POST http://127.0.0.1:18080/v1/statement with headers X-Presto-User: dos_probe and Content-Type: text/plain; body SELECT '<unique padded literal>'; intentionally do not follow returned nextUri
trigger.loop_variable: number of abandoned initial statement submissions and SQL body byte size
trigger.bandwidth_notes: 973 successful submissions * 700000 request-body bytes, about 681 MB of local loopback POST body data before failure
